source_snapshot.items: Mechanical Check w/ Drive Full Populated
source_snapshot.procedure: Insert HDDs until all slots are occupied, inspect mechanical condition, then remove one HDD.
source_snapshot.criteria: No chassis mechanical issue with all HDD slots populated.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO correctly requires onsite physical/visual inspection of drive seating, levers and full chassis.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Correctly rejects remote-only evidence but omits safe removal and data/RAID governance.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Preserves full-population and one-drive-removal actions while adding physical/storage safeguards.
historical_reviews.related_cases: Storage enumeration cannot establish latch, carrier, backplane, cable or airflow clearance.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Manual physical steps and destructive availability risks must be separated from optional automated corroboration.

original_test_intent: Verify every approved HDD/carrier seats and latches with the chassis fully populated, without backplane, cable, cover or airflow interference, and that one designated drive can be removed safely.
original_method: A qualified operator follows approved ESD and hot-swap/power procedure to populate the defined drive-slot matrix, record each fit and full-chassis clearance, remove the designated safe test drive, and restore or document the approved final population.
manual_activity: Qualified operator populates all approved bays, records mechanical/airflow condition and removes the exact approved drive using the supported power/hot-swap procedure.
required_inputs: Service manual, ESD and power/hot-swap policy
Exact removal target by slot/serial and RAID/filesystem/data impact
Qualified operator and full-population/removal photo capture
Final population, recovery and optional storage-health plan
safety_requirements: Verify every drive identity and removal target before handling
Follow ESD and vendor power/hot-swap rules
Stop on tight/loose fit, latch/cable/backplane/airflow interference, wrong drive, RAID/rebuild or thermal/storage warning
Do not remove a live non-hot-swap drive or continue after damage
Do not auto-reinsert, rebuild, power-cycle or infer fit from enumeration
agent_execution_scope: Organize operator observations/photos and optional read-only storage health
Correlate each bay/drive and removal action
Do not handle drives, infer mechanics, start rebuild/recovery or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Provide qualified operator and own storage recovery
Review physical/storage evidence and issue PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly identifies that no command can prove full-population mechanical fit or safe removal.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: No remote command substitutes; optional read-only RAID/SMART/temperature/log collection may corroborate health before and after operator actions.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Populate every HDD slot, inspect full chassis, remove one HDD and no-mechanical-issue criterion plus 10/0 timing fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Execute a controlled full-bay mechanical matrix followed by one identity-locked removal with storage-impact monitoring.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact hardware/data identity, safe service method, airflow and recovery evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No physical coverage is replaced by OS storage status.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Full population changes airflow and removal can trigger rebuild or data loss even when mechanics are acceptable.

project_override_considerations: If live removal is unsupported, power-off removal is required; hot-swap capability is never inferred from the drive form factor.
expected_evidence: Exact drive removal photos/actions and optional RAID/SMART/thermal/log evidence
Final population/recovery state and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master, DeepSeek and GPT V2 agree the authoritative result is manual physical inspection.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The case is manual rather than inherently blocked when physical resources and a qualified operator are available.

review_improvement: Adds traceable full-population and safe removal governance without diluting the physical mechanical criterion.
independent_technical_reasoning: Individual bay fit does not prove a fully populated chassis remains free of cumulative carrier, cable and airflow interference. Removing a drive also crosses from mechanics into storage availability, so stable drive identity and RAID/data state must accompany the physical evidence.
